VERDICT: LGTM

The `selfLink` addition slots perfectly into the established pattern of this mapper. It mirrors the ~16 existing derived fields exactly: a `@Mapping(target = ..., expression = "java(...(owner))")` entry alongside a matching `default` method with the same null-guard idiom and the same Javadoc style (including the "Returns `null` until ... so the field is absent" phrasing that `ageBand` already uses). The logic lives in the right unit — this is precisely the kind of DTO-derived field the mapper's default methods exist to compute — nothing is duplicated, and the class isn't becoming a catch-all beyond its existing (already-accepted) role. The OpenAPI schema entry likewise matches the surrounding `readOnly` property conventions. A maintainer would find this entirely natural.
